d:
Valencia and Athletic Club fought to a goalless 0-0 draw in a tight Matchday 9 LALIGA clash at the Mestalla Stadium.
Athletic Club controlled the flow of play with 63% possession and nearly 400 accurate passes, but Valencia's disciplined five-man backline—led by centre-back César Tárrega and Pablo Maffeo—held firm, limiting the visitors to just two shots on target. At the other end, Stole Dimitrievski and Unai Simón were sharp when called upon, both keeping clean sheets to ensure the points were shared.
